svg.title: Valkey black hole
svg.desc: A relativistic accretion disk seen at a moderate tilt, reading as a hot ring with a hole in it: white at the inner edge, gold through the middle and red at the rim, brighter on the left where the orbiting gas comes towards the viewer, lensed up over the dark shadow at the centre and crossing in front of it below, with the white Valkey hexagon mark at the centre. The title "Valkey black hole" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
